library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textmodels)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

summit \<- read_csv("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datageneration/datamethods/master/textanalytics/summit_11162021.csv")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datageneration/datamethods/master/textanalytics/summit_11162021.csv"))

dim(summit) \# 几行几列 
names(summit) \# 有哪些列

table(summit$is_retweet)                          # 转推有多少条？
range(summit$created_at)                          # 时间窗口从哪到哪？
head(sort(table(summit$lang), decreasing = TRUE)) # 主要是什么语言？

sum_twt <- summit$text
toks <- tokens(sum_twt)
sumtwtdfm <- dfm(toks)

class(sum_twt)
class(toks)
sumtwtdfm

tweet_dfm <- tokens(sum_twt, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
  dfm()

topfeatures(tweet_dfm, 20)
tweet_dfm2 <- dfm_remove(tweet_dfm, stopwords("en"))
topfeatures(tweet_dfm2, 30)

tag_dfm <- dfm_select(tweet_dfm, pattern = "#*")
toptag <- names(topfeatures(tag_dfm, 50))
head(toptag, 10)

tag_fcm <- fcm(tag_dfm)
topgat_fcm <- fcm_select(tag_fcm, pattern = toptag)
textplot_network(topgat_fcm, min_freq = 50, edge_alpha = 0.8, edge_size = 1)

user_dfm <- dfm_select(tweet_dfm, pattern = "@*")
topuser <- names(topfeatures(user_dfm, 50))
head(topuser, 20)

user_fcm <- fcm(user_dfm)
user_fcm <- fcm_select(user_fcm, pattern = topuser)
textplot_network(user_fcm, min_freq = 20, edge_color = "firebrick", edge_alpha = 0.8, edge_size = 1)

sum_lsa <- textmodel_lsa(tweet_dfm2, nd = 4)
head(sum_lsa$docs)              # 每条推文在 4 个维度上的得分

# 看每个维度上权重最高的词，帮助理解它代表什么
for (i in 1:4) {
  cat("Dimension", i, ":\n")
  print(head(sort(sum_lsa$features[, i], decreasing = TRUE), 10))
}

library(quanteda.textstats)

inaug <- corpus_subset(data_corpus_inaugural, Year >= 1945)

ndoc(inaug)                               # 一共几篇？
tail(docvars(inaug), 3)                   # 最新的是哪几篇？
table(docvars(inaug, "Party"))            # 两党各几篇？

inaug_toks <- tokens(inaug, remove_punct = TRUE)
inaug_dfm  <- dfm(inaug_toks)

stats <- data.frame(
  Year      = docvars(inaug, "Year"),
  President = docvars(inaug, "President"),
  Party     = docvars(inaug, "Party"),
  length    = ntoken(inaug_toks),
  TTR       = textstat_lexdiv(inaug_dfm, measure = "TTR")$TTR,
  Flesch    = textstat_readability(inaug, measure = "Flesch")$Flesch
)
head(stats)

library(tidyr)

stats |>
  pivot_longer(c(length, TTR, Flesch), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = value)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Party)) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw()
